visualRisks.description: The lighthouse is isolated and not connected to any road or house, which might make it seem out of place.
visualRisks.suggestion: Connect the lighthouse to a road or house for better integration.

visualRisks.description: There are no direct paths from the water (top row) to the houses in the middle rows. This could be confusing for players trying to reach specific areas.
visualRisks.suggestion: Add roads connecting the waterfront directly to at least one house.

navigationRisks.description: Rows 6 and below are completely empty, which could lead to dead ends for players who might expect more content.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Add some elements (roads, houses) in rows 6-10 to avoid dead ends.

navigationRisks.description: The route [15,27,16,28,4,17,40,52,64] has a complex path that might be difficult for players to follow.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Simplify the route or provide clearer visual cues.
